result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a prominent loading indicator is stuck over restaurant imagery, and the layout is visually obscured by the bottom navigation overlay.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, obscuring the restaurant photo and making the card appear to be in an unfinished/loading state.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image/content has loaded, or use a properly sized skeleton/loading placeholder before rendering the card.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, covering a substantial portion of its image instead of the scroll content ending above the navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation height (including safe-area inset) so list cards can scroll fully above the fixed navigation.
